comment: App store descriptors. Each candidate is one published artifact of an app.
The kernel ranks them: lash > exe > appimage > elf, and never selects a
dmg (a macOS disk image this platform cannot use).
A candidate either points at a checked-in payload, is built by a compiler
listed in "build", or is declared without one: those are recorded in the
catalogue as published-elsewhere but are not installable from the mirror.

apps.name: hello
apps.summary: greets from whichever package this machine can run

candidates.note: macOS disk image; listed so the store can skip it

apps.name: sysinfo
apps.summary: prints memory, network and uptime through the shell commands

apps.name: winhello
apps.summary: PE32+ console executable, published only as a Windows build
